column2: The ducks quacked loudly as the children threw bread into the pond.
column3: 孩子們把麵包丟進池塘時，鴨子大聲呱呱叫。
column4: ducks quack at us (鴨子對我們呱呱叫)
column5: 鴨子叫聲 quack 聽起來像在說「誇」「誇」

column2: Her voice quivered with fear as she stepped onto the stage.
column3: 她踏上舞台時，聲音因害怕而顫抖。
column4: voice quivers with fear (聲音因害怕而顫抖)
column5: 果凍很 Q，一碰就微微抖動，quiver 就是顫抖

column2: After washing, Dad racked the wet bowls so they could dry.
column3: 洗完後，爸爸把濕碗放到架子上晾乾。
column4: rack the dishes (把碗盤放上架)
column5: rack 是架子，當動詞就是把東西放上架

column2: After losing the first set, the team rallied and won the match.
column3: 輸掉第一盤後，球隊重新振作並贏得比賽。
column4: rally after a loss (落敗後重新振作)
column5: rally 像賽車拉力賽：大家拉起力氣重新振作

column2: My uncle ranches in Texas, where his cattle graze on wide grassland.
column3: 我叔叔在德州經營牧場，他的牛在遼闊的草原上吃草。
column4: ranch in Texas (在德州經營牧場)
column5: ranch 諧音「攔去」，把牛羊攔在大草原上養

column2: The strong wind rattled the windows all night long.
column3: 強風整夜把窗戶吹得咯咯作響。
column4: rattle the windows (使窗戶咯咯響)
column5: 撥浪鼓搖起來 ra-ta-ta，就是 rattle 的聲音

column2: Farmers reap the wheat in early summer before the rains come.
column3: 農夫在雨季來臨前的初夏收割小麥。
column4: reap the harvest (收穫作物)
column5: reap 收割用鐮刀；rip 才是用手撕，別搞混

column2: I reckon it will rain soon, so take your umbrella.
column3: 我覺得快下雨了，所以帶上你的雨傘。
column4: reckon it will rain (認為會下雨)
column5: reckon 像 reckoning 算一算，心裡算過就「認為」

column2: Grandpa reeled in a big fish after pulling on the line for ten minutes.
column3: 爺爺拉了十分鐘釣線後，把一條大魚捲了上來。
column4: reel in the line (把釣線捲回來)
column5: 釣魚的捲線器就叫 reel，轉一轉就把線捲起來

column2: Mr. Lin will referee tomorrow's basketball final between the two schools.
column3: 林老師將擔任明天兩校籃球決賽的裁判。
column4: referee a match (擔任比賽裁判)
column5: 球員吵架就 refer 去問他，被求助的人是 referee

column2: Queen Victoria reigned over Britain for more than sixty years.
column3: 維多利亞女王統治英國超過六十年。
column4: reign over a country (統治一個國家)
column5: reign 和 rain 同音：國王統治，恩澤如雨降下

column2: The whole town rejoiced when the flood finally began to go down.
column3: 洪水終於開始退去時，全鎮的人都欣喜萬分。
column4: rejoice at the news (聽到消息而欣喜)
column5: re 再三 + joice 像 joy 喜悅：開心到歡呼

column2: I will repay you for the lunch when I get my allowance.
column3: 我拿到零用錢就會還你午餐錢。
column4: repay a loan (償還貸款)
column5: re 回 + pay 付：把錢付回去

column2: Frogs reproduce by laying hundreds of eggs in shallow water.
column3: 青蛙在淺水中產下數百顆卵來繁殖。
column4: reproduce by laying eggs (靠產卵繁殖)
column5: re 再 + produce 生產：再生出下一代

column2: He resented being blamed for a mistake that he did not make.
column3: 他怨恨自己被怪罪於一個不是他犯的錯。
column4: resent the criticism (怨恨那些批評)
column5: resent 像 re-send 重寄：把舊怨一直重寄在心裡

column2: Many retired teachers reside in this quiet neighborhood near the river.
column3: 許多退休教師住在河邊這個安靜的社區。
column4: reside in Taipei (居住在台北)
column5: re 回 + sid 坐：坐定下來就是居住

column2: When the talks failed, the workers resorted to a strike.
column3: 談判破裂後，工人訴諸罷工。
column4: resort to violence (訴諸暴力)
column5: resort 動詞是沒辦法時最後「求助」的出路

column2: She tried to restrain her laughter during the serious ceremony.
column3: 在嚴肅的典禮上，她努力忍住笑聲。
column4: restrain your anger (克制你的怒氣)
column5: re 回 + strain 拉緊：把衝動拉緊拉回來

column2: You started it! he retorted when his sister blamed him.
column3: 姊姊怪他時，他回嘴說：「是你先開始的！」
column4: retort with a joke (用玩笑回嘴)
column5: re 回 + tort 扭：把對方的話扭轉回去

column2: The nurse revived the fainted runner with cool water and fresh air.
column3: 護理師用冷水和新鮮空氣讓昏倒的跑者甦醒過來。
column4: revive a fainted runner (使昏倒的跑者甦醒)
column5: re 再 + viv 生命：再次活力十足

column2: The villagers revolted against the king after taxes doubled.
column3: 稅金加倍後，村民起義反抗國王。
column4: revolt against the king (起義反抗國王)
column5: re 回 + volt 轉：把統治者翻轉過來

column2: The Earth revolves around the sun once every year.
column3: 地球每年繞著太陽轉一圈。
column4: revolve around the sun (繞著太陽轉)
column5: re 回 + volve 轉：轉一圈又回到原點

column2: His classmates ribbed him about his new haircut all day.
column3: 同學們整天拿他的新髮型開玩笑。
column4: rib a friend (取笑朋友)
column5: rib 是肋骨，用手肘輕頂肋骨就是開玩笑取笑

column2: Thieves rifled the drawers and took all the cash.
column3: 小偷把抽屜翻得亂七八糟，拿走了所有現金。
column4: rifle through drawers (翻遍抽屜)
column5: rifle 諧音「來福」，小偷來福到家翻箱倒櫃

column2: Tall pine trees rim the lake, making it look like a painting.
column3: 高大的松樹環繞著湖邊，讓湖看起來像一幅畫。
column4: trees rim the lake (樹木圍繞湖邊)
column5: rim 就是杯口那一圈邊緣，圍成一圈

column2: The nail ripped a hole in his new jacket.
column3: 釘子把他的新外套撕破了一個洞。
column4: rip a hole (撕出破洞)
column5: rip 的聲音像撕紙的「嘶」一聲

column2: Tiny waves rippled across the pond when the duck landed.
column3: 鴨子降落時，小波紋在池塘上漾開。
column4: ripple across the pond (在池塘上起漣漪)
column5: ripple 諧音「瑞波」，水面一圈圈小波紋

column2: No other restaurant in town can rival her grandmother's dumplings.
column3: 鎮上沒有任何餐廳的水餃比得上她奶奶包的。
column4: rival the best (比得上最好的)
column5: rival 源自共用一條河 river 的鄰居，搶水成對手

column2: Wild horses roam freely across the open grassland.
column3: 野馬在開闊的草原上自由漫遊。
column4: roam the streets (在街上閒逛)
column5: room 是待在房間；roam 是離開房間到處晃

column2: Thunder rumbled in the distance, so we hurried home.
column3: 遠方雷聲隆隆作響，所以我們趕緊回家。
column4: thunder rumbles (雷聲隆隆)
column5: rumble 的音像悶雷「轟隆」，肚子餓叫也是

column2: Dry leaves rustled under our feet as we walked through the woods.
column3: 我們穿過樹林時，乾葉子在腳下沙沙作響。
column4: leaves rustle (樹葉沙沙響)
column5: rustle 的 ss 音就像風吹葉子的沙沙聲

column2: Dad saddled the pony before the little girl climbed on.
column3: 小女孩爬上去之前，爸爸先給小馬裝上馬鞍。
column4: saddle a horse (給馬裝鞍)
column5: saddle 裡有 sad：馬背被壓著好 sad，要裝鞍

column2: The church sainted the kind nun after a long review of her good deeds.
column3: 教會審查了修女的善行很久之後，才封這位仁慈的修女為聖徒。
column4: be sainted by the church (被教會封為聖徒)
column5: saint 唸起來像「聖」，被封聖的人

column2: The soldiers saluted the flag as the anthem began.
column3: 國歌響起時，士兵向國旗敬禮。
column4: salute the flag (向國旗敬禮)
column5: 拉丁文「祝你健康」，舉手敬禮問候就是 salute

column2: The guard scanned every face in the crowd, looking for the missing boy.
column3: 警衛仔細審視人群中每一張臉，尋找失蹤的男孩。
column4: scan the crowd (審視人群)
column5: scan 諧音「斯看」，一個個仔細看

column2: The cut on his knee scarred over, leaving a thin white line.
column3: 他膝蓋上的傷口結了疤，留下一道細細的白線。
column4: scar over (結疤)
column5: scar 去掉 s 是 car：小車刮過牆留下痕跡

column2: My dog scented the cheese from across the room.
column3: 我的狗隔著整個房間就聞到了起司。
column4: scent danger (嗅到危險)
column5: scent 和 sent、cent 同音，鼻子靠味道收訊息

column2: A group of thieves schemed to steal the painting during the festival.
column3: 一群小偷密謀在慶典期間偷走那幅畫。
column4: scheme against a rival (密謀對付對手)
column5: scheme 諧音「思計」，心裡盤算計謀

column2: Many critics scorned the film, calling it silly and dull.
column3: 許多評論家輕蔑這部電影，說它愚蠢又乏味。
column4: scorn his advice (藐視他的建議)
column5: s + corn 玉米：把人看得不值一粒玉米

column2: The children scrambled up the rocky hill to reach the top first.
column3: 孩子們手腳並用爬上岩石山丘，想搶先抵達山頂。
column4: scramble up the hill (攀爬上山)
column5: scrambled eggs 是炒蛋，手腳亂動像鍋裡翻攪
